SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_SRC') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_SRC;
END;

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_DELTA') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_DELTA;
END;

WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount  
)
, TEMP_TRU AS (
SELECT CustomerId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, 'M' AS AccountHolderTypeId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' )
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,* FROM (


-- TRY --
SELECT DISTINCT
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BCAP.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM
TEMP_TRU BCAP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BCAP.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDA.SourceSystemCode AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DAHT ON DDB.BankSK = DAHT.BankSK AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DAHT.SourceSystemCode AND BCAP.AccountHolderTypeId = DAHT.AccountHolderTypeID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,BranchID,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount ) BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE BCAP.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'  
    ) A
)


SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_SRC FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT;

WITH
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator             
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_SRC
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 and SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,CASE
	    WHEN TGT.CustomerID IS NULL AND TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.CUSTOMERID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_DELTA FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_SRC SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 and TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY';




INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerAccount (
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,ShareIndicator
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT 
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,SRC.CustomerID
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,Convert(varchar,ShareIndicator)
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_SRC SRC
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
GO
